title: Two drag payloads with different drop targets: SurfaceDrag goes into panes, ClusterDrag goes on windows
context: A surface (tab) can be dropped into a pane or used to split one. A cluster can only be dropped on a window, never in a pane.
decision: Union type with `what` field: SurfaceDrag for surfaces (apps and terminals), ClusterDrag for clusters. DropTarget refuses incompatible combinations.
consequences: Drag layer knows which payload it has and refuses invalid operations. No cluster accidentally lands in a pane because it fell through the tab branches.
